channel.title: SafeOrStolen - News & Updates
channel.description: Latest news, updates, and tips on verifying stolen items, protecting yourself from fraud, and buying second-hand items safely.

item.title: Welcome to SafeOrStolen - Your Stolen Item Verification Platform
item.description: SafeOrStolen.com is now live! Verify IMEI numbers, VIN numbers, and serial numbers to ensure your second-hand purchases are safe and not stolen.

item.title: IMEI Checker - Verify Your Phone Before You Buy
item.description: Use our IMEI checker to verify if a phone is stolen, blacklisted, or reported lost. Essential for anyone buying a used phone from Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist, or other platforms.

item.title: VIN Verification - Check Vehicle History
item.description: Verify vehicle VIN numbers to check if a car is stolen, has liens, or has been reported to authorities. Protect yourself when buying used vehicles.

item.title: How to Buy Used Electronics Safely
item.description: Learn how to protect yourself when buying used phones, laptops, tablets, and other electronics. Complete guide to verification and safe transactions.

item.title: Marketplace Sellers: How to Build Trust
item.description: If you're selling used items online, providing verification builds buyer confidence. Learn how SafeOrStolen helps sellers close more deals.

item.title: Enterprise Solutions for Marketplaces
item.description: SafeOrStolen now offers API integration for online marketplaces, pawn shops, and retailers. Protect your platform and users from stolen goods.

item.title: Facebook Marketplace Safety Tips
item.description: Essential safety tips for buying and selling on Facebook Marketplace. How to verify items and avoid scams.

item.title: Understanding IMEI Numbers
item.description: What is an IMEI number? How to find it on your phone? Why is IMEI verification important? Complete guide for buyers and sellers.

item.title: VIN Number Basics: What You Need to Know
item.description: Everything you need to know about VIN numbers - what they mean, where to find them, and why verification matters when buying used vehicles.

item.title: Mobile App Coming Soon
